captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Arre beta, main aam nahi hoon, main Suraj
hoon!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Aur woh subah kitni shaanti se shuru hui
thi.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Ek nanha sa bachcha apni aankhen kholta
hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Maa Anjana phal lene gayi hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Aankhen khulin, aur bhookh bhi jaag gayi.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Maa, maa, bhookh lagi!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Maa yahan nahi hain, aur ped ke saare aam
abhi kachche hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Lekin upar aasmaan mein dikha, ab tak ka
sabse bada, sabse paka hua aam.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Aam!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Woh chhalaang lagaata hai. Ped peeche
chhoote, baadal peeche chhoote.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Vayu Dev theek peeche udte hain, use
thandi hawa karte hue,

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
jaise koi papa bachche ki pehli cycle ke
peeche bhaag rahe hon.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Surya Dev apni subah ki duty kar rahe
hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Tabhi unhe ek chhota sa munh dikhta hai,
jo bada, aur bada hota ja raha hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Teenon lokon ki batti gul.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Kahin koi poochhta hai, bijli gayi kya?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Bas ek hi roshni bachi, do chhote chhote
gaal, diyon jaise chamakte hue.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Us din Rahu ki booking thi, grahan ki.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Woh pahunchta hai, par Suraj gaayab.
Saamne bas ek bachcha, jo use hi ghoor

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: raha hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Jamun!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Rahu itni tez kabhi nahi bhaaga.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Indra Dev! Bachcha Suraj kha gaya!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Indra Dev Airavat par aate hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Bada, safed, gol matol.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Bachche ki aankhen chamak uthti hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Rasgulla!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Indra ghabra jaate hain. Vajra! Tak!
Seedha thodi par.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Hic!

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Aur Suraj wapas aa gaya. Good morning,
phir se.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Par nanha bachcha neeche gir raha hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Vayu Dev use pakad lete hain. Beta? Koi
jawaab nahi.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Vayu Dev Indra ki taraf dekhte hain, aur
hawa ruk jaati hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Jab tak mera beta nahi hansega, koi saans
nahi lega.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Saare devta daude chale aate hain, koi
khaali haath nahi.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Brahma ji bole, koi bhi astra ise kabhi
chot nahi pahunchayega.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Indra Dev, bahut sharminda, bole, yeh mere
vajra se bhi zyada mazboot hoga.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Surya Dev, abhi bhi thode ghabraaye hue,
bole, main ise padhaunga.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Aur thodi par woh chhota sa nishaan, yaani
uski hanu, usi se use naam milta hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Hanuman.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Bachcha muskurata hai. Vayu Dev muskurate
hain. Aur sabki saans laut aati hai.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text: Beta, aur kuch chahiye?

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Aur Surya Dev chupchaap ek baadal ke
peeche chhip jaate hain.

captions.speaker: NARRATOR
captions.text:
Katha pasand aayi? Toh aisi aur kathaon ke
liye follow karo.
